title: Skillet Prawn Stir-Fry
description: Quick and easy stir-fry with succulent prawns, crunchy textures, and a nutty flavor.

ingredients.name: Nutty Oils (Chili-Infused)
ingredients.notes: Available at most Asian markets or online.

ingredients.name: Portuguese Seasoning
ingredients.notes: A blend of herbs and spices, typically used in Portuguese cooking.

instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the nutty oils and swirl to coat the pan.
Add the prawns and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the crunchy vegetables and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Sprinkle with Portuguese seasoning and serve immediately.
